The implementation is complete and fully verified. Here's a summary of what was built:

## `submission/main.py` (24 KB, stdlib only: `json`, `re`, `sys`)

**Framing & validation** â one JSON request per stdin line, one response per line, independent requests. Duplicate keys are rejected via `object_pairs_hook`, strict schema checks (exact key sets per mode/op/flow/run), ID regex, lowercase-only even-length hex (round-trip canonical check), integer-vs-bool/float typing, and every documented range (nodes 1â64, capacities 0â512, flows 0â512/0â22, path 2â9, H 8â256, labels 16â1048575, events â¤20000, 2 MiB packet budget, offers/run limits, 65536 header bytes). Any violation yields exactly `{"error":"input"}` and never aborts the stream.

**Replay** â per-node table `(node,label) â flow`, entry counts for capacity, and the enabled set. `put` applies the documented check order (idempotent â busy â full â install), `enable` requires every path node to hold that flow's entry, `disable`/`reset` keep tables. Packets classify disabled â mismatch â qos â compressed (K bytes compared with one big-int mask AND), emit the one-label MPLS stack (`uint32_be((label<<12)|(Q<<9)|1<<8|ttl) || residue || payload`, swapping labels per link) or the IP fallback (header with only T rewritten), with exact TTL drop rules, reconstructed delivery bytes (K from template, D from residue, Z zeroed, Q from TC, T from final TTL) and link-byte accounting.

**Planning** â per-flow benefit from warmup-aware eligible packet counts, pinned feasibility (`{"infeasible":true}`), then an exact optimizer: non-binding nodes dropped, flows split into independent components over shared binding nodes, each solved by branch-and-bound over binding-signature groups with a per-node prefix-sum upper bound, memoised states and the (benefit, min-count) lexicographic objective.

## Verification
- `public_check.py --self-test` and `--candidate` â **pass**
- 143 hand-computed cases (byte codec, TTL edges, capacity/busy/full ordering, plan savings formulas) â **0 failures**
- ~7,000 differential fuzz cases against independently written references (replay semantics, plan brute force incl. pinned-heavy/infeasible and large 256-byte headers) â **0 mismatches**
- Performance: worst measured 0.7 s and 36 MiB stdout (limits: 30 s / 64 MiB); planner search â¤ ~2 000 nodes on adversarial structures
